timing_scope: One completed public evaluate call per dataset/source/computation/configuration, including preparation, transfer, fitting and scoring. Imports, file loading and synthetic warmup excluded. Remaining first-use work inside evaluate is included.
environment_note: Shared host with concurrent independent workers and existing caches. These are original-pass observations, not a repeated-trial estimate or isolated-machine benchmark. Interrupted attempts were restarted; only completed call durations are included.
aggregation: Arithmetic mean across five datasets, four sample sources and eleven unique computation groups: 220 equally weighted calls per configuration. Shared outputs count once. This is a mean per computation, not the latency of a combined all-metrics call.
